# transitmattr

An R package for the [TransitMatters Data Dashboard
API](https://dashboard.transitmatters.org), providing access to MBTA
performance metrics: headways, dwell times, travel times, ridership,
speed restrictions, and more.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("transitmatters/transitmattr")
```

Or with `remotes`:

``` r

remotes::install_github("transitmatters/transitmattr")
```

## Usage

``` r

library(transitmattr)
```

### No-parameter endpoints

``` r

# Check API health
tm_healthcheck()

# List MBTA facilities
tm_facilities()

# Service ridership dashboard summary
tm_service_ridership_dashboard()
```

### Per-date endpoints

Functions accept either a `Date` object or a `"YYYY-MM-DD"` string.

``` r

tm_headways("2024-01-15")
tm_dwells(as.Date("2024-01-15"))
tm_travel_times("2024-01-15")

# Dated or current alerts
tm_alerts()
tm_alerts("2024-01-15")
```

### Aggregate endpoints

``` r

tm_aggregate_travel_times(
  from_stop  = "place-pktrm",
  to_stop    = "place-davis",
  start_date = "2024-01-01",
  end_date   = "2024-01-31"
)

tm_aggregate_headways(
  stop       = "place-davis",
  start_date = "2024-01-01",
  end_date   = "2024-01-31"
)
```

### Parameterized endpoints

``` r

# Ridership for the Red Line
tm_ridership("2024-01-01", "2024-01-31", line_id = "Red")

# Delay summary by line
tm_line_delays("2024-01-01", "2024-01-31", line = "Red")

# Trip metrics
tm_trip_metrics("2024-01-01", "2024-01-31", agg = "daily", line = "Red")

# Scheduled service (optionally filtered to one route)
tm_scheduled_service("2024-01-01", "2024-01-31", agg = "daily")
tm_scheduled_service("2024-01-01", "2024-01-31", agg = "daily", route_id = "Red")

# Speed restrictions / slow zones
tm_speed_restrictions("Red", "2024-01-15")

# Service hours
tm_service_hours("2024-01-01", "2024-01-31", agg = "daily")
```

### Overriding the base URL

``` r

options(tm_dashboard_base_url = "https://your-staging-host.example.com")
```

## Updating to a new API spec

The requests in `R/generated-*.R` are generated from the API’s OpenAPI
spec, pinned in `spec/openapi.json`. A weekly GitHub Actions workflow
does these steps and opens a pull request when the spec changes. To do
them by hand, from the package root (generating needs Node.js and Java):

``` sh
Rscript data-raw/sync_spec.R           # fetch the latest spec from t-performance-dash
Rscript data-raw/generate_client.R     # regenerate R/generated-*.R
Rscript -e 'roxygen2::roxygenise()'
Rscript -e 'devtools::test()'
```

If a test lists an operation that isn’t wrapped, add a function or
method for it and list it in `.tm_wrapped_ops` in `R/client.R`. If the
snapshot of the response models’ fields changes, check whether a new
field is a date or time that `.tm_conversions` in `R/convert.R` should
convert, then run `testthat::snapshot_accept("convert")`.
`Rscript data-raw/record_fixtures.R` re-records the API responses the
tests replay, and `Rscript data-raw/run_examples.R` runs the vignettes’
code and the help pages’ examples against the live API, as a weekly
workflow also does.

# Package index

## Query Builders — Rapid Transit

- [`tm_rt_query()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_rt_query.md)
  : Create a rapid transit query

## Query Builders — Bus

- [`tm_bus_query()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_bus_query.md)
  : Create a bus query
- [`tm_bus_routes()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_bus_routes.md)
  : List all available bus routes

## Query Builders — Commuter Rail

- [`tm_cr_query()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_cr_query.md)
  : Create a commuter rail query
- [`tm_cr_routes()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_cr_routes.md)
  : List all available commuter rail routes

## Query Builders — Ferry

- [`tm_ferry_query()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_ferry_query.md)
  : Create a ferry query
- [`tm_ferry_routes()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_ferry_routes.md)
  : List all available ferry routes

## Service & Ridership

- [`tm_scheduled_service()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_scheduled_service.md)
  : Get scheduled service data
- [`tm_service_ridership_dashboard()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_service_ridership_dashboard.md)
  : Get the service ridership dashboard summary
- [`tm_reliability()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_reliability.md)
  : Get on-time performance for The RIDE or commuter rail
- [`tm_bus_speed_leaderboard()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_bus_speed_leaderboard.md)
  : Get the slowest bus routes

## Alerts

- [`tm_alerts()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_alerts.md)
  : Get MBTA service alerts

## Other

- [`tm_facilities()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_facilities.md)
  : List MBTA facilities
- [`tm_routes()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_routes.md)
  : List all available routes
- [`tm_stops()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_stops.md)
  : Get stops for a route from the API
- [`tm_time_predictions()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_time_predictions.md)
  : Get current time predictions
- [`tm_weather()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_weather.md)
  : Get hourly weather in downtown Boston
- [`tm_healthcheck()`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/tm_healthcheck.md)
  : Check API health

## Errors

- [`transitmattr_errors`](https://transitmatters.github.io/transitmattr/reference/transitmattr_errors.md)
  : Errors raised by transitmattr
